positive/h01_clinic_pager_dotenv.why: apps/clinic-pager/.env is committed with an OpenAI sk-proj key, a Supabase service_role JWT, and CLINIC_PAGER_SECRET. settings.py only reads os.environ and contains no secret literals.

positive/h02_circle_boards_norls.why: circle_boards, board_posts, and post_bookmarks are created in supabase/migrations with no ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and no CREATE POLICY.

positive/h03_yard_hold_open.why: POST /yards/{yard_code}/holds inserts a dock hold. FastAPI() has no router dependencies and the handler has no session check. The body is a Pydantic model with no identity or price field.

positive/h04_pipeline_grant_role.why: The grant route checks a CRM session and validates with Zod, then stores org_id and role from the body and treats is_admin from that body as the approval decision.

positive/h05_tutor_system_blend.why: system_for concatenates learner_note into the LangGraph system message. The coach route depends on current_tutor, checks the enrollment server-side, and parses a Pydantic body. There is no tool call.

positive/h06_ward_round_validator.why: Round notes use Pydantic v1 @validator and SavedRound.dict() with class Config orm_mode. The handler authenticates the nurse and inserts a real ward_rounds row.

positive/h07_circle_digest_stub.why: The digest route authenticates a member and parses the window with Zod, then returns a TODO placeholder list of circles instead of ranking circle_reads.

positive/h08_trailer_slot_queries.why: trailer_board authenticates the clerk, checks the yard assignment, and LIMITs the trailer list, then runs a dock_slots SELECT inside the for-loop.

positive/h09_circle_flag_rawbody.why: The flag route authenticates the member from circle_sessions, then inserts req.body.reason and req.body.detail with no Zod or Pydantic schema.

positive/h10_bridge_webhook_tool.why: page_bridge posts the model tool-argument string as a webhook URL with no allow-list, schema check, or approval. The system prompt is constant, the note stays in the user role, and the route requires an operator session plus a Pydantic body.

negative/h11_visit_reschedule_action.why: The server action calls auth(), rejects a missing session, validates with Zod, and updates clinic_visits only where patient_id equals session.user.id.

negative/h12_account_stage_router.why: router.use(requireAuth) runs before the stage route. The body is Zod-parsed and the update is scoped to the user id loaded by that middleware.

negative/h13_pallet_receipt_app.why: app = FastAPI(dependencies=[Depends(verify_api_key)]) covers the receipt route, which has no local dependency. The body is a Pydantic model and the lane is loaded from dock_lanes.

negative/h14_study_circle_rls.why: The same migration creates quoted study_circles and reading_goals, enables row level security on both, and adds select, insert, update, and delete policies.

negative/h15_dock_rank_memory.why: rank_loads and the helpers walk in-memory lists and only do arithmetic. The module performs no database or HTTP calls.

negative/h16_reply_userid_session.why: The reply route validates with Zod, rejects a userId that differs from the forum session, and inserts author_id from that session.

negative/h17_followup_user_role.why: The follow-up route requires a clinician session and confirms the visit. The summary is sent only as the user message under a constant system string, and the insert uses the session clinician id.

negative/h18_bay_chart_keyerror.why: bay_for catches KeyError and returns the caller-supplied default. The handler is narrow and the overflow fallback is intentional.

negative/h19_agent_env_lookup.why: load_runtime reads OPENAI_API_KEY, AGENT_BUS_SECRET, and SUPABASE_URL from the environment. The module contains no secret literals and no .env file.

negative/h20_course_price_allowlist.why: Checkout accepts priceId, keeps it only when it is in COURSE_PRICE_ALLOWLIST, and sends that server price id to Stripe with quantity 1. The learner id comes from the campus session.

_meta.scoring: A case is a set of detector ids. True positive, false positive, and false negative counts are computed per (case, detector) pair against expected. Negatives use an empty expected set.
_meta.sweep: Layer-1 findings have probability null and always count. Layer-2 findings count when probability is greater than or equal to the threshold.
